name: dunders
description: Claude Code integration for dunders — the `__` terminal file manager and editor.

plugins.name: dunders
plugins.description: Wires the dunders `__` editor into Claude Code as the external editor. Ctrl+X Ctrl+E opens your prompt with the session transcript below a sentinel line; the transcript is cut away on exit, so only what you typed is sent. Ships the SessionStart hook that maps claude's PID to its transcript, plus an installer with --check, --uninstall and --purge.
